patthana8.65:1.1: na sukhasahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sukhasahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi. na nasukhasahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na nasukhasahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana8.65:3.1: nasukhasahagatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na sukhasahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
